# ux

<!-- generated by `knowledge.mjs index` — do not edit -->

- [[confirm-every-action]] — No one-click mutations — every button that writes opens a confirmation or form dialog that says concretely what will change and whether it can be undone. _(rule)_
- [[help-in-popovers]] — Explanations of a field go in a question-icon popover next to its label, never as paragraphs inside the form. _(rule)_
- [[no-mixed-scale-sort]] — A column is sortable only if every row is on the same scale and unit — multi-currency amounts sort by a common equivalent or not at all. _(rule)_
- [[no-people-names-in-ui]] — Labels, help text and toasts describe roles or actions, never a specific operator's name — people change, the UI shouldn't. _(rule)_
- [[select-loading-empty-states]] — A select whose options come from data shows one disabled "Loading..." item while loading and one disabled "No data" item when empty — it never opens blank. _(rule)_
- [[server-side-lists]] — Pagination, filters and sorting run in the list RPC and are mirrored to the URL query; never filter a fully loaded array on the client. _(rule)_
- [[static-dialog-headers]] — DialogTitle/DialogDescription render static text; values that echo user input go in the form body next to their field. _(rule)_
